name: tmc-level-params
description: Level difficulty parameter harness for level designers: from a batch of theme + difficulty tier inputs (five tiers learned from the competitor difficulty labels), generate and check one parameter set per level, name every asset slot to fit its theme (agent-written, harness-checked), print every parameter, and draw the batch difficulty against the competitor.

interface.shortDescription: Generate checked parameters for a batch of theme + tier levels.
interface.longDescription: For level designers, not production. Input a batch of levels, each a theme and a difficulty tier 1-5. Five tiers are learned from the competitor mainline data: a class-balanced logistic model scores how much a level looks like the competitor Hard/ExHard levels from six parameters, and the score quantiles cut the real levels into five equal tiers. For each level the harness draws the joint form, totals, kinds, four-category split, per-kind counts, targets, stacking, moving vehicles and duration from real levels of that tier and checks every rule and that the drawn parameters score inside the tier; the same theme and tier always give the same level. show prints every parameter; overview draws the batch difficulty curve on a 0-100 % competitor ruler with each parameter against its tier range; files are level-params.json/csv/xlsx with one asset list per theme. Asset slots start as placeholders (building 1, prop 3); the agent names every slot to fit its theme (Chinese name and English id) from a template that lists each slot's role, and names-apply checks the names and writes them into every output. xlsx export needs xlsxwriter; the picture needs matplotlib.
